name: Kunwar Singh
role: Rebel chief of Jagdishpur in Bihar
contribution: Kunwar Singh, the zamindar of Jagdishpur, led one of the most important regional rebellions against East India Company rule in Bihar during 1857.
context: North and central India during the anti-colonial uprising of 1857-1859.
impact: His campaigns show how local authority, older political claims, and military resistance combined in the Bihar theatre of the rebellion.
highlight: Jagdishpur chief who led the Bihar resistance during the 1857 rebellion.
seoTitle: Kunwar Singh: Rebel Chief of Jagdishpur in 1857
seoDescription: Learn about Kunwar Singh, the Jagdishpur chief who led major resistance against East India Company rule in Bihar during 1857.
shortAnswer: Kunwar Singh was the Jagdishpur chief and a leading rebel commander in Bihar during the 1857 uprising.
